mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bi_live_retention_order_fact ( retention_id,business_date,shop_id,shop_name,order_no,owner_id,owner_name, progress,retention_result,retention_amount,referral_success,referral_shop_id, referral_shop_name,referral_order_no,referral_amount,freight_collected,freight_amount, first_followed_at,completed_at,completion_seconds,source_version, source_created_at,source_updated_at,synced_at,is_deleted ) SELECT o.id,DATE(o.created_at),o.shop_id,COALESCE(s.shop_name,''),o.order_no, o.owner_id,COALESCE(u.nick_name,''),o.progress,o.retention_result,o.retention_amount, o.referral_success,o.referral_shop_id,COALESCE(rs.shop_name,''),o.referral_order_no, o.referral_amount,o.freight_collected,o.freight_amount,o.first_followed_at,o.completed_at, CASE WHEN o.progress='COMPLETED' AND o.completed_at>=o.created_at THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,o.created_at,o.completed_at) ELSE NULL END, o.version,o.created_at,o.updated_at,NOW(),0 FROM live_retention_order o LEFT JOIN erp_shop s ON s.shop_id=o.shop_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=o.owner_id LEFT JOIN erp_shop rs ON rs.shop_id=o.referral_shop_id LEFT JOIN bi_live_retention_order_fact b ON b.retention_id=o.id WHERE b.retention_id IS NULL OR b.is_deleted=1 OR b.source_version<>o.version OR b.source_updated_at<>o.updated_at ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE business_date=VALUES(business_date),shop_id=VALUES(shop_id),shop_name=VALUES(shop_name), order_no=VALUES(order_no),owner_id=VALUES(owner_id),owner_name=VALUES(owner_name), progress=VALUES(progress),retention_result=VALUES(retention_result), retention_amount=VALUES(retention_amount),referral_success=VALUES(referral_success), referral_shop_id=VALUES(referral_shop_id),referral_shop_name=VALUES(referral_shop_name), referral_order_no=VALUES(referral_order_no),referral_amount=VALUES(referral_amount), freight_collected=VALUES(freight_collected),freight_amount=VALUES(freight_amount), first_followed_at=VALUES(first_followed_at),completed_at=VALUES(completed_at), completion_seconds=VALUES(completion_seconds),source_version=VALUES(source_version), source_created_at=VALUES(source_created_at),source_updated_at=VALUES(source_updated_at), synced_at=NOW(),is_deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE bi_live_retention_order_fact b LEFT JOIN live_retention_order o ON o.id=b.retention_id SET b.is_deleted=1,b.synced_at=NOW() WHERE o.id IS NULL AND b.is_deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT s.source_count sourceCount,b.bi_count biCount, s.retention_amount sourceRetentionAmount,b.retention_amount biRetentionAmount, s.referral_amount sourceReferralAmount,b.referral_amount biReferralAmount, s.freight_amount sourceFreightAmount,b.freight_amount biFreightAmount, (s.source_count=b.bi_count AND s.retention_amount=b.retention_amount AND s.referral_amount=b.referral_amount AND s.freight_amount=b.freight_amount) matched FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) source_count,COALESCE(SUM(retention_amount),0) retention_amount, COALESCE(SUM(referral_amount),0) referral_amount,COALESCE(SUM(freight_amount),0) freight_amount FROM live_retention_order) s CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) bi_count,COALESCE(SUM(retention_amount),0) retention_amount, COALESCE(SUM(referral_amount),0) referral_amount,COALESCE(SUM(freight_amount),0) freight_amount FROM bi_live_retention_order_fact WHERE is_deleted=0) b
